description: AI Agents (inside one system): Use when the person asks for this in a system whose AI agent may change records: A record put into one of the person's own workflows or campaigns, which then runs its steps, and may send messages. Only the person can approve it. Give one item per record, at most 25. Nothing is written yet: the answer shows, per record, what it holds now and would hold after, plus a proposal id. Show it to the person, say so first when something would be sent to the people in their system, ask whether to go ahead, and only then call apply_proposal; when needsApproval is true, share the approve link instead. Not for reading (use search_records or get_record).

items.description: One object per record, at most 25.

automation_kind.description: A workflow, a campaign or a sales sequence; workflow when left out.

id.description: The id of the record in the system.

sender.description: For a sequence: the email address of the user it is sent from, connected to the system.

start_at.description: When it starts, ISO 8601 in UTC; now when left out.

workflow.description: The id of the workflow, campaign or sequence, as list_items gives it.

system.description: Which AI agent: the system's id from get_ai_agents_info, or the name of the system or its connection. Ask the person which AI agent they mean unless they named it in this conversation; never pick one yourself.
